title: Each type explaining their job to their parents
caption:
'But what do you actually DO?' Anyone with a modern job title has heard it.

One made a diagram (the parents framed it). One explains it differently every time, so the parents believe they have four jobs. One just shows the promotion letter. Swipe to find your strategy.

The useful bit: parents rarely need the job title. They need to hear that you're okay, and why the work matters to you.

Send this to a sibling, then send it to your parents.
